description: Show several pictures of a drawing at once as a titled gallery, for example one image per layer, per sheet, or per detail. Each entry takes what cad.render_view takes (view, handle, onlyLayers, hideLayers, onlyHandles, region, width, height, dark) plus a title; settings given outside renders apply to every entry. Use this, rather than several cad.render_view calls, whenever the user asks for more than one image. The pictures appear in a widget; set imageForModel to be handed them yourself as well.

imageForModel.description: Hand the picture to you as an image block as well. Off by default where the host draws the widget: the user already sees the render, and the image block is the same bytes again. Set it true when you need to look at the drawing yourself — checking geometry, a layer filter, or whether you picked the right view.

renders.description: One entry per picture, in order.

handle.description: Layout, block or named-view handle from cad.list_render_views.

region.description: [minX, minY, maxX, maxY]; default fits the content.

width.description: Default width for every entry; 800 keeps eight pictures small.

name: cad.show_renders
